title: Shared models package, repo scaffolding and check script
description: Read ARCHITECTURE §2-4, §12, API.md §1-5. Create the repo scaffolding: README.md (build/run/deploy overview), .gitignore, .dockerignore (ARCH 5.20: allow only packages/yams_models, gateway, app/build/web; exclude **/.dart_tool and app/build/web/**/*.symbols), the shared analysis_options.yaml, and tool/check_all.sh. The script runs `dart analyze packages/yams_models` FIRST, then analyze+test for each existing package (yams_models, gateway, updater, app via `source ~/development/env.sh`). Last comes a docker build smoke: create a placeholder app/build/web/index.html if missing, build gateway/Dockerfile and updater/Dockerfile (skip each Dockerfile that does not exist yet, and skip with a warning when docker is unavailable). Package yams_models: `sdk: ^3.13.0`, deps meta, dev test+lints via `dart pub add`; commit pubspec.lock. Write json.dart (ARCH §4 helpers). common.dart: ApiError (fields, details, retryAfterSeconds), PagedList<T> (NOT Page), CursorPage<T>, ItemList<T>, non-generic Section with decode<T>(), SectionStatus, Alert + AlertSeverity, ServiceId and ExternalApp (both include shelfmark), ExternalLink, Job/JobStep/JobStatus, CommandRef. auth.dart: LoginRequest, LoginResponse (top-level serverProofKey), TokenPair, User/Role, SessionInfo, MeResponse with its seerr part (SeerrQuota, QuotaInfo), CreateUserRequest, UpdateUserRequest, JellyfinUserOption, AuditEntry, ChangePasswordRequest. server.dart: ServerPing (optional proof), ServerConfig (externalApps map incl. shelfmark, policy, features incl. containerActions, seerr flags), HealthReport, ServiceHealth. dashboard.dart: DashboardResponse. arr_common.dart: ArrService, QualityInfo, MediaFileInfo, HealthMessage, ArrHistoryType with the int mapping, ArrHistoryItem. Every enum has `unknown`; follow the naming rule and reserved-names list of ARCH §4. creates_stubs (create once with `// <feature> DTOs: written by the <feature> slice.`, export from yams_models.dart, never touch again): packages/yams_models/lib/src/{requests,library,activity,calendar,indexers,subtitles,containers,system,media}.dart. Tests: round trips and unknown-enum parsing for every core DTO.

title: Gateway core: config, pipeline, auth, upstreams, images, jobs, health, dashboard, stubs, test support
Flutter app core: project, platform config, shell, routing, networking, auth, launcher, shared widgets, stubs
description:
Read ARCHITECTURE §2.1, §3, §7 (all), §12, §13 and APP.md §1-3, §13-15.

Setup: `flutter create --org dev.zenith --project-name yams_hub --platforms android,ios,web app`. DELETE app/test/widget_test.dart. Run the exact `flutter pub add` command of ARCH 2.1 (pinned go_router ^17.5.0, cached_network_image ^3.4.1 + cached_network_image_platform_interface, dynamic_color ^1.9.0, flutter_riverpod '>=3.0.0 <3.5.0', flutter_secure_storage 11, device_info_plus, web, collection, flutter_web_plugins sdk, yams_models path, dev fake_async). Set environment `sdk: ^3.13.0`, `flutter: ">=3.47.0"`. Commit pubspec.lock. Never add material_ui. Every file imports package:flutter/material.dart.

Platform config (7.11):
- Android: INTERNET, cleartext, <queries>, allowBackup=false, magnet: intent filter, minSdk = flutter.minSdkVersion.
- iOS: 15.0, ATS, local network text, LSApplicationQueriesSchemes, CFBundleURLTypes magnet.
- flutter_deeplinking_enabled=false, plus a tiny MethodChannel `dev.zenith.yams_hub/links` for incoming links → core/intents routes to AppPaths.activityAdd(url:).
- Web: index.html/manifest.json with display standalone, start_url /home, 192/512 + maskable icons, apple-touch-icon; no Google Fonts.

Core code (§7):
- theme with StatusColors and DynamicColorBuilder; app_settings incl. hiddenLauncherApps.
- Server profiles and ServerResolver: happy-eyeballs, server proof via /ping?nonce&sid, Tailscale-first when unverified, plain-HTTP warning.
- TokenStore (secure storage v11 with first_unlock_this_device; web cookie no-op / dev sessionStorage via package:web; stores sessionId and serverProofKey).
- Dio: /api/v1 bearer or /yh/api/v1 cookie; X-YAMS-Client always; no release LogInterceptor. Interceptors: Auth with single-flight refresh, where the refresh Dio copies baseUrl and X-YAMS-Client; Failover that retries only GET/HEAD or connectionError/connectionTimeout, else ApiException.resultUnknown(); Error.
- Login (device_info_plus device names) and onboarding screens.
- go_router StatefulShellRoute with 12 branches; ShellScaffold (compact/medium/expanded); AppPaths with EVERY helper listed in ARCH 7.3.
- navBadgesProvider polling GET /dashboard?cards=... every 30 s and seeded by dashboardProvider, reading the raw keys of API.md §4.
- Dashboard screen with alerts panel, DashboardCardFrame and the card registry.
- More screen.
- Web-apps launcher (core/launcher: /home/apps, dashboard section and More entry, from GET /server externalApps + GET /health, members included).
- jobProvider(id) + JobChip.
- Shared widgets of 7.9 incl. HubImage (ImageRenderMethodForWeb from the platform interface, /yh prefix rewrite on cookie transport), InfiniteList over PagedList/CursorPage, ConfirmDialog/TypedConfirmDialog.
- core/platform helper (no dart:io in features); external_links incl. shelfmark.

creates_stubs (create once, never touch again):
- app/lib/features/{requests,library,activity,calendar,media,containers,indexers,subtitles,system,settings}/<f>_routes.dart: root GoRoute plus every APP.md §1 sub-route as PlaceholderScreen, static sub-routes first.
- app/lib/features/<f>/<f>_dashboard_card.dart for the nine card features (not settings), with the ARCH §12 signature.

Test support: FakeApi (Dio adapter serving canned JSON), pumpHubApp, model builders.

Core tests: AppPaths outputs match registered routes and every API.md alert route parses; failover retry rules; token store; server proof verification; navBadges raw-key parsing; launcher filtering.

Acceptance: flutter analyze clean, flutter test green, `flutter build web --release --no-web-resources-cdn` succeeds.

title: Requests (Seerr): discover, search, titles, requests, issues
description:
Implement API.md §6 and APP.md §4; upstream facts in integrations/seerr.md.

DTOs: TitleCard, TitlePage, RequestSummary (seerrMediaId, libraryId = media.externalServiceId, downloads as RequestDownloadProgress), MovieTitle, TvTitle, MediaState, RequestEligibility, TvSeason, SeasonEpisodes/SeasonEpisode, Ratings, CreateRequest/CreateRequestResult, RequestCounts, RequestOptions/ServiceOptions (prefixed sub-types RequestOptionsProfile, RequestOptionsRootFolder), Issue, IssueUser, IssueComment (commentCount in lists), IssueCounts (others→other, closed→resolved), Genre. IssueStatus has unknown. Follow the ARCH §4 prefix rule.

Gateway:
- Use ctx.seerrIdentity for X-API-User (never your own cache), ctx.jellyfin.itemLink/serverId for Jellyfin links, ctx.seerrSettings for flags. Seerr strict query encoding via rawQuery.
- Watchlist per user via `GET /user/{seerrUserId}/watchlist`, cache keyed by Seerr user id; unlinked members get an empty TitlePage. Write a test for admin vs member watchlist.
- `declined` filter: take=500 fetch, 15 s cache, gateway-side paging with exact totals.
- Issue comment/resolve/reopen as the user, upstream 403 → 403.
- quota_exceeded details carry the quota; invalidate the quota cache on create.
- Dashboard card RequestsCard: keep the raw key counts.pending; alerts seerr.pending/seerr.failed with valid routes.

App: discover carousels (watchlist hides when empty), search, title detail with the request/season sheet and the quota line from meProvider, requests list/detail with Open in Library via AppPaths from libraryId, issues with commentCount and creator/admin resolve. Card widget. Tests per ARCH 5.19/7.12.

title: Library (Sonarr/Radarr) incl. interactive release search
description:
Implement API.md §7 (incl. §7.8 releases) and APP.md §5; upstream facts in integrations/arr.md (§9.2 for releases).

DTOs: SeriesSummary/MovieSummary with `tags` (resolved via /api/v3/tag, cached 10 min), Episode, EpisodeQueueState, SeasonInfo, SeriesDetail, MovieDetail, SeriesLookup, MovieLookup, AddSeriesRequest, AddMovieRequest, WantedItem, LibraryProfiles (prefixed sub-types LibraryQualityProfile, LibraryRootFolder), LibrarySummary/ArrSummary, ReleaseChoiceList/ReleaseChoice, LibraryCard.

Gateway:
- All routes of §7 with static segments first (lookup, episodes, releases/grab before <id>). Paths include /api/v3.
- Release search: GET episode/season/movie releases, 150 s timeout, one per user (409); releaseId tokens hide guid/downloadUrl. POST /library/releases/grab → POST /api/v3/release {guid, indexerId}; 404 when expired.
- Commands, wanted, profiles, summary.
- Delete with policy/confirm and 428 impact text.
- Dashboard card and alerts (§7.11).

App: Library tabs, series/season/movie detail with tag chips, the release picker sheet ("Choose release" in episode, season and movie overflows; rejected releases greyed and confirmed), add flow, history, wanted multi-select, typed delete confirm. Card widget. No real indexer calls in tests; build queue records from the arr.md §9 schema as *.synthetic.json files.

title: Activity: torrents, unified queue, manual import, transfer, VPN, history
description:
Implement API.md §8 (incl. §8.3.1 manual import) and APP.md §6; upstream facts in integrations/downloads.md and arr.md §9/§9.1.

DTOs: TorrentState, TorrentSummary, TransferState, QueueItem, QueueArrEntry (downloadId, canManualImport, links to the *arr /activity/queue), QueueResponse, TorrentList, TorrentDetail, ShareLimits, TorrentFile, TrackerInfo (url reduced to scheme://host[:port]), CategoryList, VpnStatus + VpnGluetunHealth, ManualImportCandidates, ManualImportFile, TorrentActionRequest, ActivityCard.

Gateway:
- qBittorrent maindata DemandPoller via QbitSession; unified queue merge.
- Queue remove/grab/refresh, and manual import: GET candidates via /api/v3/manualimport (path kept behind a fileId token), POST /api/v3/command ManualImport.
- Torrent actions, with managed_by_arr 409. Share-limits is [confirm] for remove/removeWithContent.
- torrents/add through UpstreamClient.send multipart (URLs passed to qBittorrent, never fetched by the gateway).
- Transfer, VPN, merged history cursor (core merged_cursor).
- ActivityCard keeps the raw key counts.attention. Alert queue.import.<key> routes to /activity?tab=queue&import=<key>.

App:
- Queue tab with attention tiles (Import… and Open in Sonarr/Radarr), the manual-import sheet (also opened from the import= query), torrents tab with the admin FAB Add torrent.
- Add-torrent sheet and route /activity/add?url= (magnet links from core intents; web-only .torrent picker via package:web behind a conditional import).
- Torrent detail with confirm flow for share-limit deletes, transfer settings, VPN sheet ("Restart VPN" via the containers action plus JobChip).
- Card widget. Never import dart:io.

title: Calendar agenda
description: Implement API.md §9 and APP.md §7. CalendarResponse/CalendarItem/CalendarCard (keep the raw key countNext7Days). Gateway: Sonarr+Radarr calendar with YAMS_HUB_TZ_OFFSET day bounds. `downloading` comes from BOTH the Sonarr queue (episodeId) and the Radarr queue (movieId), each cached 5 s; failures are ignored. One item per movie release date in the window; 62-day max window; 5 min cache. App: agenda grouped by day with sticky headers, filters, Today FAB, tablet month grid, navigation via AppPaths.seriesDetail/movieDetail. Card widget. Queue samples are synthetic (arr.md §9 schema).

title: Indexers (Prowlarr) incl. SSRF-safe manual grab
description:
Implement API.md §10 and APP.md §10; upstream facts in integrations/downloads.md §3.

DTOs: Indexer, IndexerTag, IndexerStats, IndexerList, IndexerHistoryItem, IndexerCategory, IndexerTestResult, ReleaseList/Release, IndexersCard (raw key `failing` array).

Gateway:
- Reads/writes; tests as jobs.
- Manual search: 150 s, one per user; releaseId tokens.
- Grab: magnet → qBittorrent. Otherwise rewrite Prowlarr download URLs to PROWLARR_URL (key in the header, apikey query removed), or fetch https public URLs only through ctx.remoteHttp (manual redirects, public-IP check). Magnet redirect handled; 5 MB streaming cap; bencode check; downloadUrl never logged. Upload via multipart; create category `manual` if missing.
- Test that a redirect to http://socket-proxy:2375 is refused.
- Static routes before <id>.

App: list with enable switches and multi-select, detail, history, manual search with grab sheet, Test all job sheet (core JobChip/jobProvider). Card widget. testall bodies are synthetic.

title: Subtitles (Bazarr)
description: Implement API.md §12 and APP.md §11; upstream facts in integrations/downloads.md §4. DTOs: SubtitleLanguage, WantedSubtitle, SubtitleHistoryItem, SubtitlesSummary, SubtitleJob, SubtitlesCard (raw key missingEpisodes). Gateway: Bazarr paths with the /api prefix, writes as query params, search-all is [confirm], task ids validated against the cached task list, posters via ImageUrls.arr. App: header with providers/SignalR, Episodes/Movies/History tabs, language-chip searches polling /subtitles/jobs, admin overflow actions with confirms. Card widget.

title: Containers, updates and maintenance
description:
Implement API.md §11 and APP.md §9; upstream facts in integrations/system.md §1-3, §8-9.

DTOs: ContainerSummary, ContainerDetail, ContainerHealthLogEntry, ContainerEvent, LogLine, LogResponse, ContainerList, UpdateInfo, UpdatesResponse with lastScan (WatchtowerScan from /v1/metrics, plus /v1/status), DecluttarrStatus, RecyclarrStatus, ContainersCard (raw keys running/total).

Gateway:
- DockerClient paths without /v1.54.
- EXACT-NAME resolution against /containers/json for every {name} route; ids and prefixes return 404. Tests: an id prefix of a locked container → 404; `..` → 404.
- Locked/confirm/gluetun→qbittorrent coupling. Actions disabled when features.containerActions is false.
- healthLog output admin-only, redacted, 200 chars; LogLine.text redacted.
- Docker events stream and stats poller in start().
- The ONLY caller of Watchtower /v1/check (6 h + on request, 5 min rate limit), cached via ctx.stores updates.json.
- Updater calls with /updates/{service} validated against the updater /services allow-list; job logs redacted.
- Decluttarr/recyclarr parsers; recyclarr sync via updater /exec/recyclarr-sync.
- Static routes (events, updates, maintenance) before <name>.

App: grouped list, detail with health log (admin output), logs viewer, Updates screen with the Watchtower last-scan strip even when available=false, maintenance cards; all actions via core JobChip/jobProvider and ConfirmDialogs. Card widget.

title: System: host metrics and Uptime Kuma
description:
Implement API.md §13 and APP.md §12; upstream facts in integrations/system.md §4-5.

DTOs: HostMetrics (+ prefixed sub-types), MetricSeries, UptimeResponse, SystemCard.

Gateway sampler (start(), every 5 s, ring buffer 1 h/24 h):
- reads /proc/stat, meminfo, loadavg, uptime, cpuinfo, mdstat and diskstats (dm-0) from the container's OWN /proc;
- network from HOST_NET_DEV;
- hwmon under HOST_SYS/class/hwmon (default /sys), resolving the relative symlinks safely (dangling entries skipped). The test fixture builds a temp tree with symlinked and one dangling hwmon entry.
- statvfs(/data) via ffi; missing sources → flags false.
- The diskstats sample is synthetic.

Uptime Kuma status page (UTC beats). Alerts raid.degraded, raid.noRedundancy, host.temperature, host.volume, uptime.down.<id>, uptime.incident with valid routes.

App: host/storage/network/uptime/service-health cards (health row tap targets incl. shelfmark → AppPaths.mediaShelfmark()), charts with explicit fl_chart text styles, updated missing-source texts. Card widget.

title: Media: Jellyfin, Jellystat, Audiobookshelf, Kavita, Shelfmark
description:
Implement API.md §14 (incl. §14.7 Shelfmark and §14.8 launcher/card) and APP.md §8; upstream facts in integrations/seerr.md §2-3 and system.md §6, §7, §12.

DTOs: NowPlayingSession, NowPlaying, MediaItem, JellyfinOverview, WatchStats, WatchUser, PlaybackRecord, AudiobooksOverview, BooksOverview, BookSeries, ShelfmarkStatus, MediaApp (app enum incl. shelfmark), MediaCard (incl. shelfmark counts).

Gateway:
- Use ctx.jellyfin (serverId, itemLink, adminUserId; never your own cache) and ctx.health for MediaApp status/version.
- Members' /media/stats/history is scoped to their own linked jellyfinUserId.
- Shelfmark: only GET /api/health and GET /api/stats. NEVER /api/status, /api/restart, /api/debug, /api/localdownload, /api/releases, /api/metadata/search or any write.
- Kavita with the x-api-key Auth Key, missingKey handling, never Account/login. Jellystat dangerous routes never called.
- Alerts: kavita.auth → /media/books, jellyfin.restart → /containers/jellyfin, shelfmark.coordinator → /media/shelfmark.
- Kavita samples are synthetic (*.synthetic.json).

App: Now playing, Stats (fl_chart with explicit text styles), Apps tab with five rich tiles (link to /home/apps), Jellyfin/Audiobookshelf/Kavita/Shelfmark detail screens (/media/shelfmark with the Open Shelfmark button), stats/users. Card widget.

title: Settings screens (app only)
description:
Implement APP.md §13 using only core endpoints (API.md §2) and core providers.
- Servers list/editor (hidden on gateway-served web; plain-HTTP warning).
- Account (POST /auth/password), sign out.
- Sessions (own; admins all).
- Users (admin): CRUD via /admin/users, and a Jellyfin user dropdown from /admin/jellyfin-users with an "Import into Seerr" button (confirm → POST /admin/jellyfin-users/{id}/import-to-seerr); "No Seerr account" chips.
- Audit log (admin) with filters.
- Appearance: theme, dynamic color, seeds, dashboard cards checklist/order, and the web apps checklist writing appSettingsProvider.hiddenLauncherApps.
- Refresh presets.
- Media apps: per-ExternalApp base URL overrides and custom schemes.
- About: versions, health, public URLs, the Tailscale-on-untrusted-Wi-Fi note, licenses.
There is no gateway or models code in this slice.

title: Updater sidecar and deploy files
description:
Read ARCHITECTURE §5.17, §5.18, §6, §8, §9, §10.

updater/: Dart shelf service, `sdk: ^3.13.0`, deps shelf, shelf_router, args, logging, crypto; commit pubspec.lock. Dockerfile: dart:3.13 build with `mkdir -p /out`; distroless cc final with the docker:29-cli docker binary and compose plugin; runs as root.
- Token read from UPDATER_TOKEN_FILE (`UPDATER_TOKEN='...'`); refuse to start if it is under 32 bytes. Constant-time Bearer check returning 401 on EVERY path, including unknown ones. Request bodies never logged.
- Allow-list from `docker compose -p yams --project-directory /opt/yams -f ... -f ... config --services` every 10 min. UPDATER_DENY default yams-hub,yams-hub-updater,socket-proxy-hub. {service} validated by regex + allow-list.
- Routes: GET /healthz, GET /services, POST /update/{service} (one job at a time). Steps: `compose pull -- svc`, `up -d --no-deps -- svc`, gluetun also force-recreates qbittorrent, then `docker image prune -f`. Process.start with argument arrays, 15 min timeouts.
- POST /exec/recyclarr-sync with a CONSTANT argument array (test asserts it). GET /jobs/{id}.
- Tests with a fake process runner.

deploy/:
- docker-compose.hub.yaml exactly as ARCH §6: yams_hub_ctl internal network; IPv4-only 0.0.0.0:8090; secrets bind mounts; /proc/1/net/dev mount; no hwmon; user 64090; pinned socket-proxy with monitor-only=true.
- yams-hub.example.yaml (5.2.1 incl. shelfmark).
- make_hub_env.sh per §9: printf to a mktemp file, no secrets in argv, JELLYFIN_ADMIN_USER_ID default, UPDATER_TOKEN 48 bytes, chown/chmod via `docker run --rm alpine`, --drop-bootstrap, final check-config.
- verify.sh with the 7 checks of §6.
- tailscale-acl.example.hujson (§8).
- deploy.sh (§9; compose -p yams, delete *.symbols).

Scripts must be shellcheck-clean. Do NOT run anything against the NAS.
